title: Counter-evidence — Dust Choir (challenger claim, earlier creation)
report: The challenger 0x27645f863a4fbE3a6Cb13707546B55D8Be77125a is the true creator of 'Dust Choir'. The challenger created this work on 2026-09-20, fifteen days earlier than the registered creator's stated creation date of 2026-10-05. The creation is anchored by a signed message: the challenger signed the text 'Dust Choir by 0x27645f863a4fbE3a6Cb13707546B55D8Be77125a 2026-09-20' with the challenger wallet. The work was first published on 2026-09-21 in the gallery 'Early Static', listing the challenger as the artist. The registered creator's later date of 2026-10-05 cannot be the first creation of this work.
